_comment: Operational settings (timeouts, concurrency, retries, candidates per batch) are read from here. The model parameters ("params") and the prompt files below are ONLY the initial seed: on first start they become version 1 of each model in Admin → AI Prompts & Params, which is from then on the single source of truth (p3/modelconfig.py). Editing them here has no effect once seeded.

params.prompt: The ring in the reference is rigid and frozen. Preserve every element exactly. Pure white seamless studio background. Only the camera moves, orbiting smoothly around the ring at a constant speed.

charm._comment: Seeds of the Charm models, read once (when a charm model has no version yet). Provider settings are copied from the active Ring version at that moment; these prompts are the charm's own. Afterwards Admin → AI models & prompts → Charm is the source of truth.
